test.command: python -m pytest -q tests/test_trade_data_quality.py tests/test_forward_feed_health.py tests/test_forward_edge_f03.py; ruff check src/financial_brain/forward_edge/trade_data_quality.py tests/test_trade_data_quality.py

implemented: Uses a threshold policy frozen before the observation window for quote staleness, spread, and volatility.
Matches feed-gap intervals only when they overlap the decision-to-entry window and retains event IDs.
Requires complete feed coverage and quote/volatility evidence IDs before labeling a trade CLEAN_OBSERVED.
Separates system issue, clean observed, and incomplete populations with net INR and losing-trade counts.
Explicitly disclaims causal attribution and strategy promotion from data-quality strata.
blockers: Trades and health events are caller-supplied; no live durable journal integration is present.
The classification report is not surfaced in daily paper results or the operator cockpit.
Observational stratification cannot establish that system conditions caused losses or prove a clean-data edge.
